REASON.unknown: No safe detail is available. Check the problem list.
REASON.reputation: Recent failures or spam reports require a review before sending continues.
REASON.provider: The sending service has restricted delivery. Ask your administrator to review the service status.
REASON.unsubscribed: This person chose not to receive emails. Respect this choice.
REASON.complained: This person reported an email as spam.
REASON.permanent: A permanent delivery failure was recorded; this does not always mean the address does not exist.
REASON.temporary: A temporary delivery failure was recorded.
REASON.nonexistent: The recipient server confirmed that this mailbox does not exist.
REASON.invalid: Review the address format and domain.

EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_PROTECTION.TITLE: Sending paused to protect your next emails
EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_PROTECTION.SCOPE: Internal account assessment. This is not an official sender-domain score.
EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_PROTECTION.ANALYSIS_ONLY: Analysis only: these findings did not prevent sending.
EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_PROTECTION.ENFORCED: Protection active: blocked addresses are excluded from sending.
EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_PROTECTION.CLASSIFICATION: Each row has one main classification.
EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_PROTECTION.PENDING_COUNTS: Analysis is incomplete; totals are not yet available.
EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_PROTECTION.RETRY_COUNT: Recorded retry/failure counter: {count} (not total sending attempts)
EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_PROTECTION.METRICS_HINT: Totals include past delivery, opening and click events; filters show the current recipient status. Server acceptance does not guarantee inbox placement. Openings are estimates, not proof of human reading; automated scanners can also record clicks.
EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_PROTECTION.ERROR: Could not complete this action. Please try again.
EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_PROTECTION.STILL_BLOCKED: Sending is still paused. Review the current assessment.
EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_PROTECTION.IMPORT_QUEUED: List received. Import queued; you can leave this page.
EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_PROTECTION.IMPORT_PROCESSING: Importing the list. Sending is unavailable until it finishes.
EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_PROTECTION.IMPORT_SUMMARY: Added: {imported} · Duplicates: {duplicates} · Invalid: {invalid} · Excluded from sending: {suppressed} · Total: {total}
EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_PROTECTION.DELIVERY_HINT: Totals may include acceptance by the sending service; delivery to the recipient server is not always confirmed.
